title: SQL Injection - Admin Login Bypass
impact: Authenticate as the administrator without valid credentials, gaining full access to all accounts and data.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements and never concatenate user input into SQL.

title: SQL Injection - UNION-Based Data Extraction
payload_used: ')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM Users--
impact: Extract every user's email address and password hash directly from the database.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and an ORM; validate and allowlist search input.

title: Reflected XSS - Product Search
impact: Execute arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser via a crafted search link (session theft, phishing).
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and a strict Content-Security-Policy on reflected input.

title: Stored XSS - Registration Email in Admin Panel
impact: Persisted script runs in the administrator's browser when the user table renders, enabling admin session hijacking.
remediation: Sanitize and encode user input server-side before storage and on render; enforce CSP.
